title: 3 tips so you stop hitting your Claude limit
description:
Most people hit their Claude limit way faster than they need to, and it's almost always fixable. Three I run every day:

1. Default to Sonnet, save Opus for real strategy. Opus eats your weekly limit about 5x faster.
2. When a chat gets long, ask Claude to summarise it into bullets and paste those into a fresh chat. In Claude Code, type /compact.
3. New topic = new chat, always. Long chats make Claude re-read the whole history every message.

Bonus for Claude Code: drop "no filler, three to six word sentences, direct answers only" into your CLAUDE.md. Output drops about 40%.
